interpretation: Faithful source loading plan. Issued steps are not data-ready barriers. No fake completion or fabricated responses.

execution.earlyCacheScope: Current authenticated connection and role only; clear on reconnect/account generation change.
execution.commonAck: Match m_api to the exact request. Any nonzero error must remain visible/retryable; never mark required data ready. Never consume unrelated heartbeat acknowledgements.
execution.pumping: Original GameStateSplash invokes UpdateStep up to 15 times/frame; issue through start barrier then allow other nonbarrier reads concurrently. Pump inbound data on main thread.

completionModes.response: Required data/condition must be satisfied before final DONE
completionModes.issued: Original marks done immediately after conditionally issuing requests; responses still update modules
completionModes.aggregate: No wire message; requires all preceding milestones

steps.name: REGISTER_AND_LOGINING

requests.fields: Full source LoginMgr login fields after HTTP auth and SESSION_TOKEN_NTF; connection layer owns this request

steps.condition: LOGIN_ACK decoded successfully for chosen role and NetMessageMgr.isLogin true; COMMON_ACK for LOGIN_REQ is not a success response
effects: Update userInfo from actual login response
Reset login/reconnect state
Initialize avatar/login state without logging jwt or credentials

steps.name: SYNC_TIME
steps.condition: Valid TimeNtfInfo.m_t received for this connection; unsolicited notification may arrive before loading coordinator starts
effects: timebase.tLocal=local monotonic ms; tServer=m_t; tRunTotal/tLastUpdate=0
hasSyncTime=true

steps.name: USER_INFO
steps.condition: Valid complete UserAssets notification applied; this misleading step name refers to resources, not USER_INFO_NTF
effects: Replace authoritative userAssets
Initialize current food/energy/oil/steel/cash/d2o/rareEarth presentation values
Notify item resource update

steps.name: SAVE_INFO
steps.condition: ClientSaveInfo parsed and tutorial state initialized; empty content means new tutorial data, not skip tutorial
effects: Parse TutorialSaveData_B2 JSON
New save defaults order1/step0/tutorialVer3
Original old incomplete tutorial migration writes order100/step100/isStepComplete=true and sends CLIENT_SAVE_REQ; record this write explicitly if retained

steps.name: DAILY_LOGS_INFO
steps.condition: DailyEventInfo parsed and SetRawQuestInfo applied
effects: Populate daily event state

steps.name: NATION_QUEST_INFO
steps.condition: Original marks step done immediately after sending; response populates actual quest list
effects: Request all main quest progress from begin id0

steps.name: DAILY_AND_ALLIANCE_INFO
steps.condition: Only CLIENT_DATA_LOAD_ACK with ClientDataInfo.m_key exactly SaveBlackListData marks this legacy milestone done; unrelated key ACKs must not satisfy it
effects: Daily quest list and countdown updates processed independently
ClientSaveDataMgr.Set(m_key,m_value)
Blacklist application code is commented in source; do not invent its effect

steps.name: MAIL_INFO
steps.condition: Four requests issued, no wait for mail lists in original step
effects: Initialize each mail category
Unsubscribe/resubscribe one reconnect handler to avoid duplicate refreshes

steps.name: ALLIANCE_INFO
steps.condition: No alliance OR AllianceMemberAckInfo.m_brief.m_alliance_id equals current own alliance; do not accept another alliance's response
effects: Update ownAllianceInfo/members/permissions and related minimap/territory state
Original sorts member names/permissions

steps.name: HELP_INFO
steps.condition: Original marks done immediately after conditional send
effects: Apply alliance help list when response arrives

steps.name: CONFIG_CONST
steps.condition: ConstInfo received; original marks any nonnull ConstInfo done, robust new coordinator should correlate keyword=max_building_level without silently accepting another request
effects: Store ConfigConst[m_keyword]=m_val when key nonempty

steps.name: CITY_INFO
steps.condition: Own building list notification parsed and applied; BUILDING_UPGRADE_ACK is not this milestone
effects: Populate building state, tile/building IDs and build progress from full notification
Drive actual city model after scene loads

steps.name: RESEARCH_LIST_INFO
steps.condition: Original marks issued immediately; response replaces research list and updates lock flags/UI
effects: Rebuild gResearchList from response, no local invented tech levels

steps.name: RALLY_LIST

requests.condition: in alliance and normal world; GVG branch uses GVG_RALLY_LIST_REQ with map guid and node
no alliance and HQ>=15 and normal world not locked; GVG branch uses GVG_RALLY_DEFENCE_REQ
KVK not ended and in alliance
KVK not ended, no alliance and HQ>=15; source KVK personal branch reuses this nonKVK symbol

steps.skipWhen: No alliance and HQ<15; KVK branch also skips when ended
steps.condition: Original marks immediately after RequireRallyList and RequireKVKRallyList
effects: Populate ordinary/KVK rally lists separately; do not fabricate KVK progress before its data is known

steps.name: JOIN_APPLY_LIST
steps.condition: Issued/skipped immediately. Despite the step name this requests alliance technology, NOT join applications
effects: Apply alliance research state

steps.name: PERSONAL_INVITE_LIST
steps.condition: Original marks immediately after conditional request
effects: Update personal alliance invitations

steps.name: ALLIANCE_GIFT
steps.condition: Original marks immediately after request/skip
effects: Unsubscribe then subscribe AllianceGiftMgr reconnect callback exactly once
Populate gift list and fortune chest, no claim requests at startup

steps.name: EXPEDITION_INFO
steps.condition: Original marks after issuing both
effects: Register UTC midnight refresh once
Populate expedition state/store without starting challenge or buying

steps.name: SERVER_SETTING
steps.condition: Original marks immediately; settings callback also marks done on certain errors
effects: Apply server settings; do not send setting writes merely for acceptance

steps.name: GOVERNMENT_INFO
steps.condition: Original marks immediately
effects: Populate government state; no appointments or other mutations

steps.name: DONE
steps.condition: All previous step conditions completed; FinishLoading invoked once; no success on timeout
effects: Reset curStepWaitingIndex=Invalid and hide loading
Legacy FinishLoading requests IAP product lists (read-only catalog, not purchase)
Legacy loads ShutUpTime/GetFaceBookReward and writes client version/platform; these server writes must be explicitly accounted for and omitted during read-only acceptance unless approved
Load local Agent/invite/explore/collect/march/KVK/radar/activity-board cache and isolate by role

requires: building models and resource labels reflect server state
input not blocked by stale loading overlay
